::::: {.headline .g-col-lg-8 .g-col-12 .g-col-md-12}

I am a data scientist at the Innovation Lab of the French National Institute of Statistics ([Insee](https://www.insee.fr/fr/accueil)) 🇫🇷. My work focuses on leveraging new data sources and innovative methods to develop reliable statistics on socioeconomic phenomena. I have a particular interest in the analysis of textual and spatial data.

I mostly work with `Python` {{< fa brands python >}}, {{< fa brands r-project >}} and `Javascript` {{< fa brands js-square >}}. Most of my work, both personal and professional, is available on my {{< fa brands github >}} [GitHub page](https://github.com/linogaliana) or the {{< fa brands github >}} [GitHub page](https://github.com/inseefrlab) of Insee's Lab.

I currently teach [*Python for Data Scientists*](https://pythonds.linogaliana.fr/) {{< fa brands python >}} at [ENSAE Paris Tech](https://www.ensae.fr/), one of France's top engineering schools. You can find the course materials on the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/linogaliana/python-datascientist) {{< fa brands github >}}.

Additionally, I teach a course on [_Data Science Projects in Production_](https://ensae-reproductibilite.github.io/website/) at the same institution. This course addresses state-of-the-art MLOps practices, with materials available on the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/ensae-reproductibilite/website) {{< fa brands github >}}.

I have developed a course on [Good Practices in `R` and `Git`](https://inseefrlab.github.io/formation-bonnes-pratiques-git-R/). Additionally, I used to teach an [Introduction to {{< fa brands r-project >}}](https://rgeo.linogaliana.fr/) ([GitHub repository](https://github.com/linogaliana/r-geographie) {{< fa brands github >}}), an introductory data analysis course at [Ecole Normale Supérieure](https://www.geographie.ens.psl.eu/introduction-aux-methodes.html).

Among my main open-source projects, I maintain the [`utilitR` project](https://www.utilitr.org/), a collective effort involving many contributors from the French administration to provide high-quality documentation for the {{< fa brands r-project >}} software. I also developed [`cartiflette`](https://inseefrlab.github.io/cartiflette-website/), a project designed to offer data scientists working with spatial data easy access to France's geographic borders, facilitating the production of maps.

Since I enjoy using my professional tools for personal projects, I developed [climbtracker](https://github.com/linogaliana/climbtracker) ⛰️🚲, a website that helps road cyclists find ascents in their surrounding areas.
